parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment explicitly states an action: "I suggest presenting these main experimental results in a more compact and coherent way instead of deferring most of them to the appendix." This is a direct suggestion. Moreover, the comment supplies concrete details on how to apply it: it identifies the specific missing results (A-DDIM and PNDM absent from the main text, and quantitative results missing on datasets beyond CIFAR-10) and the specific fix of presenting them in the main text rather than deferring them to the appendix. The authors thus know exactly what needs to be done: add the named missing baseline and dataset results to the main text and present them there in a compact, coherent way. This satisfies the rubric requirement of an explicit action with concrete implementation details, so characterizing the action as vague on execution does not follow from the evidence.
